answer: Each identity locks 8 POA for 20 epochs, and anyone may file a bounty claim showing two identities share a funding source. Three random validators replay the ledger's transfer graph; if confirmed, 50% of the stake is slashed and half of that goes to the reporter. Every extra fake adds 8 POA of bond plus another pairwise link a hunter can mirror and expose, so a cluster of n faces n(n-1)/2 evidence paths, and even an umber-thin disguise cannot reach the summit of the rewards unnoticed.
